title: UNGA Reel:
title_short: UNGA Reel · A Machine Doesn't Have a Heart
headline: The skills young people need most are the human ones. A machine doesn't have a heart.
story: NFTE's panel asked how to build human skills in an AI world. After it, two guests answered on camera. Kirsten Theuns (Aflatoun) says young people need compassion, because a machine doesn't have a heart. Kate Parsons says perseverance: working through things that have no easy answer. Two short panel lines sit between them.
It ends on Kate's answer to "The one skill AI can't replace is…": human connection and collaboration. Warm and hopeful. Not a recap of the day, not a city video.
do: Open on frame 1 with Kirsten already saying "a machine doesn't have a heart".
Let the two reflections carry the video. The panel lines are short bridges.
Cover every pause cut with reception B-roll.
Keep the button text up until Kate speaks.
Keep captions on the whole time.
